config.title: agy-dart IDE Panel
config.defaultTab.description: Default active tab when opening the panel.
config.statusBar.enabled.description: Show live agy-dart & telemetry status capsules in the bottom status bar.
config.statusBar.showCache.description: Show live prompt cache hit rate and cache warmth alert status bar capsule.
config.statusBar.showSpeed.description: Show generation speed, request errors, and slow first-token wait status bar capsule.
config.statusBar.showQuota.description: Show active model quota pool (5h / weekly) status bar capsule.
config.refreshIntervalSec.description: Status bar polling interval in seconds (3-60).
config.defaultScope.description: Default telemetry scope in the agy-dart guard tab.
config.capsule.cacheWarnMin.description: Minutes since last activity before cache badge turns yellow.
config.capsule.cacheColdMin.description: Minutes since last activity before cache badge turns red.
config.capsule.queueWarnSec.description: First-token wait threshold in seconds before showing wait alert.
config.pluginPath.description: Optional custom path to the installed agy-dart plugin directory (auto-detected when empty).
config.nodePath.description: Optional path to Node.js (>=22) executable used to run managed workers (auto-detected when empty).
